initialExam.title: NEET PG 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)
initialExam.description: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduate medical admissions. Gateway to MD/MS/PG Diploma seats in medical colleges across India.
initialExam.eligibility: MBBS degree from a recognized university. Completion of internship on or before 30 September 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: 200 MCQs covering all 19 subjects of MBBS curriculum including Medicine, Surgery, OBG, Pediatrics, Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pathology, Microbiology, Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, Ophthalmology, ENT, Dermatology, Psychiatry, Radiology, Anaesthesia, Orthopaedics.
initialExam.examPattern: Computer-based test. 200 MCQs, 800 marks, 3.5 hours. Each correct answer: 4 marks. Negative marking: -1 mark.
initialExam.selectionProcess: NEET PG Score → Counselling (AIQ + State quota) → Seat Allotment → Admission
initialExam.jobRole: MD/MS/PG Diploma leading to Specialist Doctor positions in government hospitals
initialExam.careerGrowth: Junior Resident → Senior Resident → Assistant Professor → Associate Professor → Professor → HOD.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit nbe.edu.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 10+ for Specialist Doctors in government

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance), Medical, Pension, Academic incentives

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: No age limit for NEET PG
